summary: Round 2 at role base 309aa0a336eea71a77a5e630ae7674c57ad2ccf7 (HEAD equals that SHA at the read). The author fixed round 1 in 5bded9cf8 and recorded Daniel's look pick in 309aa0a33. All round 1 findings F1 to F13 are resolved: the not-found page now has a pinned helper (parseStorytimePath), a pinned server-to-client split (not-found-view.tsx with usePathname), and a pinned open-week function (highestOpenWeeks); every other 404 case is enumerated in AC-1.2; the playing label has pinned keys and values; every Phase 1 task names its test file; the song Red test now fails at the base; AC-1.9 names both pages; the decodable case change names the r2 test; the 404 parity rule is named; the five route files include questions.tsx (Phase 2); the 404 resource is named as /favicon.ico with an app/icon.png fix; the counts and the 'item 6' wording are fixed. Two new Majors remain: the r3 adversarial test hard-codes the same upper-case text but is not named, and the two new English-valued keys in messages/th.json break the Latin-only rule of phase3-messages.test.ts, which the plan does not extend. No Blocker is open, so the verdict is pass.
nonblocking_findings: F14 [Major] plan.md 1.2 / spec AC-1.10: The plan names phase3-adversarial-r2-pieces.test.tsx but not phase3-adversarial-r3-pieces.test.tsx, which hard-codes the same upper-case text at lines 43-44, 93, 99, 134, and 142. Rationale: Green breaks both files, so the suite stays red after the fix and the author must update r3 in the same commit.

F15 [Major] plan.md 1.1 / spec AC-1.10: The plan adds notOpenEnglish and openWeekEnglish with English values to messages/th.json, but phase3-messages.test.ts flags every Latin-only Thai value and its allow list holds only notFoundEnglish. Rationale: the pinned keys break that test unless the plan extends ENGLISH_VALUE_KEYS, and AC-1.10 says only that the test holds key parity.

F16 [Major] spec AC-1.2: The AC names /th/st/9/1 as a level with no week file, but LEVEL_MAX is 4, so that path is an unparsable path and never reaches the openWeeks lookup. Rationale: the empty-level branch needs a parseable level with no file (3 or 4); the named case passes for a different reason and leaves the branch untested.
F17 [Nit] spec FR-2: The council source path uses the placeholder <set>, while the hero fix names s1-storybook-quest/round-1.md. Rationale: wording only; it does not change the build.

F18 [Nit] spec FR-2: The text still says "Daniel's pick is asked" and gives a default that "stands at 2026-11-10 12:00", while task 2.1 and AC-2.1 record the pick on 2026-11-07. Rationale: stale wording; the plan and AC-2.1 are clear.
